conflicts.detail: CON-0199 says the model choice for a role does not belong in the role frontmatter and lives in `llm.roles.<rolle>` instead. CON-0023 (llm configuration schema, unified provider config) is the contract that governs the `llm` section of config.yaml. Its title and status give no sign that it defines a `roles` map. If CON-0023 does not define `llm.roles.<rolle>`, a role's model reference points at a config key that no contract defines.

resolution.reason: Bestehend seit SPEC-0053/SPEC-0061: llm.roles und llm.profiles definiert CON-0212; SPEC-0065 ergänzt nur eine Kontextquelle in CON-0199 und berührt die Modellwahl nicht.

conflicts.detail: CON-0190 holds the config validation rules (required fields, provider enum, provider consistency). It does not mention role entries under `llm.roles`. That leaves `sdd config validate` (CON-0191) unable to reject an `llm.roles.<rolle>` entry that names a role with no `.sdd/roles/<rolle>.md` file, or a provider that doesn't exist.

resolution.reason: Bestehend: sdd config validate prüft llm.roles über role_config_issues (SPEC-0053 FR-04, SPEC-0061); von SPEC-0065 nicht berührt.

conflicts.detail: CON-0106 also describes the `llm_pool` section of config.yaml, which assigns models. With CON-0199 adding `llm.roles.<rolle>` as a second place to pick a model, no contract says which one wins: the role assignment or the pool or provider default.

resolution.reason: Bestehend: llm_pool ist seit SPEC-0062 durch llm.roles/llm.profiles abgelöst (Migration in sdd upgrade); SPEC-0065 ändert an der Modellwahl nichts.

conflicts.detail: CON-0231 INV-05 has the decomposer create tasks of type `test` that only cover existing behaviour and change no code. Tests like that pass right away, so they never have a red phase. CON-0061 G-01 (and the pipeline's RED gate that follows from it) requires tests to fail before implementation (Red → Green). Neither contract says whether `test` tasks skip the red phase or how passing immediately counts. Without that rule, such tasks get stuck at the RED gate or escalate.

resolution.action: CON-0231 INV-05 ergänzt: Tasks vom Typ test haben keine rote Phase, ihr Test muss sofort grün sein (Gate test, SPEC-0061 FR-06); danach Review ohne Implementer.

conflicts.detail: CON-0097 (SPEC-0026) defines how `sdd decompose` sets each task's type (complexity/context_size/type). CON-0231 INV-05 adds a classification rule for the `decomposer` role ("secures existing behaviour only" → `test`). The two don't contradict each other, and `test` is allowed in the CON-0096 enum. But the classification logic now lives in two contracts. CON-0097 should point to CON-0231 INV-05, or the rule should be stated in one place only.

resolution.action: CON-0231 INV-05 stellt klar: die Regel gilt für die Rolle decomposer der Pipeline; die Klassifikation von sdd decompose (CON-0097) bleibt unverändert.
